_readme: Pages the app-shell audit treats specially. marketing = intentionally marketing-only even when signed in (reason required). dual = public + app pages: signed in = app shell, signed out = marketing header + footer. ignore = link targets that are not browsed pages (auth, sign-out landing, etc.).

dual.suggestions: public ideas board; app shell when signed in
dual.features/creators: Creator Hub landing, linked from the app menu (How it works); app shell when signed in

ignore.checkout: payment page, has its own flow (shell present, covered by payments tests)
ignore.overlay: OBS overlay, no chrome by design
ignore.stream-overlay: OBS overlay, no chrome by design
ignore.contact: only linked from the banned-account notice
ignore.features: marketing features index, only linked from the marketing flyout (nav-features.js, hidden when signed in)
ignore.refund-policy: legal text linked from checkout, public
ignore.market-data-terms: legal text linked from live-data checkout and settings, public (same as refund-policy)
ignore.help: own signed-in member shell (#member-help-shell: Questions | My tickets), public FAQ signed out; covered by help-center-browser.js and member-support QA

noheader.charts: full-screen chart app: its own toolbar replaces the phone header; menu and dock still present

nooverflow.roadmap-admin: admin table page, pre-existing wide table (not member-facing)
